headline: NASA satellites detected 13,241 fire spots in Pakistan's Punjab between October 1 and 29, 4.2 times the 3,158 in Indian Punjab, according to a HamariHawa analysis reported by Dawn.

card.desc: NASA satellites ne 1-29 October ke darmiyan yeh fire spots detect kiye.

caption:
Pakistani Punjab mein aag ke 13,241 spots, Indian Punjab se 4.2 guna zyada!
Dawn ke mutabiq HamariHawa ke analysis mein NASA satellites ne 1 se 29 October tak Pakistani Punjab mein 13,241 fire spots detect kiye, jab ke Indian Punjab mein 3,158. Inn mein se 92 percent kheton mein thay. IQAir ke mutabiq 31 October dopehar 1 baje Lahore ka AQI 232 tha.
Smog se bachne ke liye aap kya kar rahe hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
